definition: an official count of all the people
description: On a snowy shore in Antarctica on a clear, sunny day, with white icebergs floating on the dark blue sea behind, a young woman in a yellow beanie, a red padded jacket, black trousers and gloves stands beside her backpack. A line of gentoo penguins with black backs, white bellies and orange beaks waddles past her one by one, and she points at each of them, counting, then lowers her arm. Further along the shore people in red and dark jackets work beside a white box, and footprints cover the snow.

taps.phrase: to point at the passing penguins
